note: total_pct_of_wall is a difference of two whole runs, so it carries each run's deferred compilation as well as the diagnostics themselves, and the diagnostics-off run compiles less -- read it as an upper bound. write_steps_pct_of_wall comes from a separate step-breakdown run on the same arm and config, so sampling_pct_of_wall is a difference across two measurements rather than one decomposition, and only its sign and rough size are meaningful. The 120-step nsys window cannot answer this at all: it is shorter than the 720-step daily write period.
